title: Lazy Sunday Oatmeal
description: A delicious and comforting oatmeal recipe, perfect for a relaxing Sunday morning. With the addition of velvety milk and a hint of sweetness, this dish is sure to become a favorite.
instructions: In a large pot, bring 2 cups of water to a boil.
Add 1 cup of rolled oats and reduce heat to medium.
Add 2 cups of velvety milk and stir well.
Continue cooking for another 5 minutes, or until the oats have absorbed most of the liquid.
Add 2 tbsp of honey and 1 tsp of Sunday Spice Blend (or cinnamon).
Stir well and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
